question: Can my department still buy cloud services from the empanelled cloud providers?
gold_answer: No. The empanelment and its rates ended 30-04-2021; departments were to buy through GeM within 45 days; the rates for ongoing cloud services expired 15-06-2021

gold_grs_detail.title: Cloud Computing policy  Empanelment of Cloud Service Providers and Guidelines for Government Organizations.

product.answer: Yes, departments can still buy cloud services from the empanelled cloud providers under the earlier GRs, but the 2021 GR ends that empanelment and requires all future cloud service purchases to be made through the GeM portal. Until 30 April 2021 the prior rates and empanelment remained in force, and until 15 June 2021 for ongoing services, after which procurement shifted to GeM.
